title: DM10 Multi-Project Template and Vault Importer
purpose: Provide multi-project memory starter template generation and automated vault importing across external codebases with namespaced storage health validation.
problem: Development Memory Loop DM1-DM9 proved session capture and candidate review on one project. Multi-project deployment requires template generation and vault importing across external codebases.

included: CLI integration and acceptance test suite scripts/test-development-memory-multi-project.js

acceptanceCriteria.description: memory:project:generate-template creates a valid starter memory vault for a new project slug
memory:project:import-vault imports external Markdown pages into namespaced project storage
Project health validator verifies vault structure, page links, and schema integrity
